profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, traded under the ticker COUR, that was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its SEC CIK is 0001651562. On its own site it describes an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with instruction from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. It also describes Coursera Plus, an annual subscription that it says gives learners unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site names programs in AI, data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering, including the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. Coursera describes these as job-aligned programs designed with employers and universities, and says learners commonly move into roles in project management, UX design, and data science.

No lawsuits are listed for the company, and no MCP servers are listed. A legal exposure count for California lists 281.
